name: Lucky Deep Cleanroom Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Lucky Deep Cleanroom Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian-based company with a significant manufacturing facility of 25,000 Sq.Ft in a 72,000 Sq.ft. land.
summary: Lucky Deep Cleanroom Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the design and manufacture of modular cleanroom solutions and HVAC systems, focusing on cross contamination control. Their products are essential for maintaining controlled environments in industries such as electronics, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology.
